reason: The manager is currently blocked from accessing their account (P2). Reply: answered by help centre F01.
draft_reply: Hoi Marloes, ga naar app.roosterly.nl/login, klik op "Wachtwoord vergeten" en vul je e-mailadres in. De resetlink is 60 minuten geldig. Heb je binnen 10 minuten geen e-mail ontvangen, controleer dan je spambox. Vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F01.
summary_en: Marloes, a manager on the Basis plan, has forgotten her password and cannot log into her account.
back_translation_en: Hi Marloes, go to app.roosterly.nl/login, click "Wachtwoord vergeten" and enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. If you have not received an email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

reason: Payroll export data is incorrect and the payroll run closes this Thursday (P2). Handoff: not covered by the help centre: Why are night shifts appearing with doubled hours in the Nmbrs payroll export?.
handoff_note: The customer is experiencing a bug where night shifts crossing midnight are doubled in the Nmbrs export. The payroll run closes on Thursday, so this requires urgent investigation by a human support agent. Related ticket(s): T013.
route: Handoff: not covered by the help centre: Why are night shifts appearing with doubled hours in the Nmbrs payroll export?.
summary_en: Dennis from Café Noorderhaven reports that night shifts crossing midnight are incorrectly doubled in the Nmbrs payroll export before Thursday's payroll run.

reason: Money is directly involved as the customer is reporting a double charge (P2). Handoff: client rule, refunds and disputed charges always go to a human.
handoff_note: Customer reports a double charge of 312 euros for October and requests a refund. A human agent needs to investigate the billing records and process the refund. Client rule: refund_or_dispute.
route: Handoff: client rule, refunds and disputed charges always go to a human.
summary_en: The customer states that payment for October was charged twice and requests a refund for one transaction.

reason: It is a feature request with no urgency (P4). Reply: answered by help centre F10.
draft_reply: Beste klant, bedankt voor je idee. We lezen elk idee en functieverzoeken gaan op onze openbare roadmap op roadmap.roosterly.nl, waar je op ideeën kunt stemmen. We kunnen geen opleverdatum beloven voor individuele verzoeken. Met vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F10.
summary_en: The customer is asking for a dark mode feature in the app for staff working night shifts.
back_translation_en: Dear customer, thank you for your idea. We read every idea and feature requests go on our public roadmap at roadmap.roosterly.nl, where you can vote on ideas. We cannot promise a delivery date for individual requests. Sincerely, Team Roosterly

reason: This is a standard how-to question with no urgency or blocking issues (P4). Reply: answered by help centre F02.
draft_reply: Beste Anouk, je gaat naar Team → Medewerker toevoegen om een nieuwe medewerker toe te voegen. Vul de naam, het e-mailadres en de contracturen in en klik op Uitnodigen. De medewerker ontvangt dan een e-mail om de app te installeren. Vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F02.
summary_en: Customer Anouk wants to know how to add a new employee who starts on Monday.
back_translation_en: Dear Anouk, you go to Team → Add employee to add a new employee. Enter the name, email address and contract hours and click Invite. The employee will then receive an email to install the app. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

reason: Multiple users are blocked right now during operating hours (P1). Handoff: P1, needs a human right away.
handoff_note: The customer is experiencing a critical outage with Error 503 across three locations affecting the lunch shift. Check status.rosterly.nl or escalate to engineering immediately.
route: Handoff: P1, needs a human right away.

route: Handoff: client rule, refunds and disputed charges always go to a human.
